rows.whatWasRepaired: CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP only. Thirteen flattened checkbox appearances that drew at roughly twice their intended position now draw on their own /Rect.
rows.theChange: One argument at one call site: fitAppearancesToRect: true at the finalizeOfficialForm call in scripts/build-census-v1-wv_conv_nonviolent_felony-set.mjs. The flag is FIX61's, already present in the shared finalizer and default-off, so no other family sharing that finalizer is affected by this call passing it. The shared module scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-widget-appearance-placement.mjs was NOT edited; it is correct as written.
rows.visualDefectsNote: Null in both, never 0. This lane is not an independent reader and rendered no pages for judgement. It matters which way this null falls: the counter read 0 BEFORE the repair while VF08's independent read of the rendered pages found boxes stamped over the form's own title, the petitioner's name line and the body of the statutory recital. A 0 here would have been the blind spot, not the measurement.
rows.countersNote: The eight measurable counters were computed with the repository's own contract at both ends: node scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family 'wv_conv_nonviolent_felony-set', exit 0 and PASS_COMPLETE before (at 25c56504a) and after. They are identical because none of them can see this defect, which is the point of DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE.json and the reason this row does not rest on them.
rows.requiredOptionsMissingNote: The dispatch passed a figure of 11. It is not in the repository -- vf08/rows.json carries no row for this family and vf08/repair-assignments.json no entry -- and it measures 0 on both the pre-repair and post-repair bytes. Reading /Matrix is the term the original defect test omitted, and it is what distinguishes a corrected box from a doubled one.

obligations.evidence: 13/13 absolute-BBox appearances land on their own /Rect in both fixtures; 0 off paper; 57 origin-anchored placements unmoved.

obligations.whyItDoesNotClose: It was never a placement defect. The build ticks none of the four page-1 eligibility recitals by design. Two are declared NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE because they are the W. Va. Code Sec. 61-11-26a branch and this family is Sec. 61-11-26. The other two turn on the nonviolent determination and the same-transaction analysis, which the committed record calls legal conclusions and which Sec. 61-11-26(p)(5) makes express findings of the circuit court. A build lane ticking either would assert a judicial finding on a petition sworn before a notary, and the record additionally records it as a self-help stop condition. Moving the court's own empty box outlines back onto their controls does not make those elections and must not.
obligations.whatChangedForTheParticipant: Before the repair the participant had no box to tick. Now the boxes are on their controls and can be ticked -- by the participant, on advice, which is where this election belongs.

rows.holdReason: One of two failed obligations is closed. This row does not ask for release, and the family stays FAIL until ROUTE_OPTIONS is dispositioned by a lane competent to do so, which is not a build or repair lane.

Its builder calls normalizeWidgetAppearancePlacement at lines 466 and 549 before sanitizeAndFlatten.
Not affected and not touched, on the same measurement. Its builder is a four-line re-export of runWvFamily from the multiple-misdemeanors host, so it shares the normalized path.

sharedModuleVerdict.why: Matrix' = Matrix x A x translate(-Rect.x, -Rect.y) is exactly ISO 32000-1 12.5.5 less the translate pdf-lib's flatten() prepends. On an origin-anchored BBox with identity Matrix, A is translate(Rect.x, Rect.y) and Matrix' is the identity, so the correction is a proven no-op and is additionally skipped by MIN_CORRECTION_POINTS.

latentTrapForWhoeverOwnsTheOtherModule.where: fitAppearanceStreamsToRect in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-active-content.mjs guards a case rcap-widget-appearance-placement.mjs does not: one appearance stream shared by widgets needing different mappings. It groups by ref, edits the first in place and copies the stream for the rest.
latentTrapForWhoeverOwnsTheOtherModule.theTrap: The placement module folds the correction into the stream's own /Matrix per widget with no such grouping, so a second visit both overwrites the first widget's mapping and re-reads its own mutated Matrix.
latentTrapForWhoeverOwnsTheOtherModule.liveOrLatent: Latent. It cannot fire on SCA-C906 or SCA-C900, whose widgets each own their stream. Not changed here; flagged for whoever owns that module.
